messages:
maria.g: Quick sync — vendor asked for credential rotation during the pen test window. Need: pre-signed evidence links, ephemeral CMK grants, RBAC rotations, and a tentative retest hold. Who owns creds rotation?
ashok: I can own rotation. Proposal: rotate assessor creds 1h before window, issue ephemeral creds in the reading-room VM only, TTL 8h.
lia: KMS plan: create ephemeral CMK & issue a grant scoped to vendor principal with EncryptionContext pt_id=ACME; auto-revoke after 8h. Ensure all kms:Decrypt events are logged to CloudTrail and forwarded to SIEM.
sam: I'll generate presigned S3 URLs limited to prefix `pt/2026-02-acme/` with 48h expiry and deny s3:DeleteObject for that prefix. Will post links to the ticket only.
maria.g: Also enforce vendor IP/ASN allowlist in the bucket policy for the test window. No other sources.
security-bot: Created SEC-PT-612: checklist -> rbac, creds-rotation, cmk-grant, s3-presigned, ip-allowlist, cloudtrail-snapshot.
ashok: Role `pt_assessor_rotating` created, TTL=8h, tags: pt=acme, owner=ashok. Role ARN posted to SEC-PT-612.
lia: CMK grant created at 1781234600 and limited to vendor principal. Snapshot job scheduled at 1781234650 to capture logs pre-window.
ops-oncall: I'll monitor. Alert rule: if KMS AccessDenied >5 in 5m, escalate to sec-ic. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/pt-incident.
maria.g: Tentatively reserve retest slot Fri 11:00-13:00 (48h buffer). We'll confirm after dry-run tomorrow 09:30.
sam: Dry-run artifacts staged; reading-room creds uploaded to SEC-PT-612. Presigned link posted there.
maria.g: Thanks all. Short checklist review 09:15 then dry-run 09:30. :white_check_mark:
